errors.http_406_basis: A 406 (connection limit) arrives as a stream error message and is written as stream_error, then stream_conflict or stream_down with its code; the run has no stream_error, stream_conflict, stream_stopped or stream_refused record. The IEX stream, the one with a 406 wait, was not requested.
errors.http_429_basis: None recorded. A failed REST call is written as a <source>_error key in its sweep (snapshots, screener, EDGAR, halts, FINRA, daily bars) or as http_<code> in the option-chain counts; no sweep has either for 429. The daily-bar loader retries a failed request without writing it (monitor.py AdvLoader), so a 429 absorbed by such a retry would not appear in the files.
errors.console: two bash job-control notices from the non-terminal interactive shell; the monitor wrote nothing to stdout or stderr

basis: Code: monitor.py's REST requests all go through Http.get, which builds a urllib Request without a body (a GET), behind the fail-closed per-source budget. Its sources list no order, position or activity endpoint; the stream connections subscribe to news, OPRA trades and corporate-action events. Its docstring: 'Data only: it never places, changes or cancels an order.'

Recorded calls: the trading host's rate-limit reading stayed at the start-up asset-list response in all 2,874 sweeps, and no budget refusal was recorded. Option contracts, the only other trading-host source, had a cap of 0.

Broker listing: the coordinator's read-only reconciliation of account 2 lists 18 orders between 11:00Z and 13:45Z, all mvr-pre-20260929-, and 22 between 20:00Z and 00:10Z, 21 mvr-ext-20260929- and 1 rec-ext-20260929-. No listed order lacks a paper-series prefix. No broker read covers 07:55Z-11:00Z or 13:45Z-20:00Z.

data_purpose.what_the_data_is: A point-in-time record, with receive times, of the market-side and non-market-side incentive sources the forward study is built on. The protocol states why a forward study is needed: several board components have no usable history, and halt and news receive times exist only from the monitor's first day.
data_purpose.account: forward-protocol-v1.json line 63 designates alpaca-paper-2 as the study's isolated account; this run used that account's key pair for data and asset-list reads only.
data_purpose.v1_binding: This run cannot feed a protocol v1 decision. Its board.json carries monitor code sha256 88f3423a5426c32e2b22e1b7cb8bb504feb4f5093d356c4e2372de69b61e0551, while v1 is bound to monitor.py 4c8029e5f8b96e65aa630923e36fd5ddfa51a1adfa18533113d3e6ce7642eaef and board_scan.py 0912f48b108ee680d71258ab7c63f47516fdd5dc658cdb69418f17d25fd1ff03 (monitor.FROZEN_V1). The frozen v1 bridge would refuse this board with monitor_code_mismatch, and this code's bridge refuses v1 decisions with code_not_frozen (board_scan.py). Using boards from this code needs a new protocol version (incentive-monitor README).
data_purpose.licence: licensed market data and news, kept private (incentive-monitor README)

limitations: Data-only run: it evaluates no strategy and qualifies no gate. The boards are unvalidated detectors fixed without outcome data.
Code identity rests on hashes read on 2026-09-30 (clone file, git show, the frozen SUMS) and on the process's own code_sha256 in board.json, which it computed at start.
The launch script and unit files are private and matched by modification time, not by a hash taken at run time; the Python version was read on 2026-09-30.
The journal holds no exit record. The exit status and result come from the service manager's retained properties, read on 2026-09-30.
No broker read covers 07:55Z-11:00Z or 13:45Z-20:00Z on account 2. For those hours the no-order statement rests on the code and the recorded calls.
429s absorbed by a retry in the daily-bar loader would not be recorded. 57 Alpaca calls and 1 SEC call fall outside sweep windows and are not attributed by source.
19 sweeps ran longer than 20 s and 14 sweep intervals exceeded 25 s; the monitor records no per-source timing, so the cause is not in the files.
options-large.jsonl rows carry the trade time (trade_ts) but no receive time, although the incentive-monitor README says every record carries the monitor's receive time.
The FINRA files this run fetched are in the monitor's shared finra/ directory and are not hashed here.
The data is licensed market data and news and stays private; only hashes, counts and times are published.
evidence_note: Built from the private monitor outputs (monitor.jsonl, the boards and every data file, read-only), the engine clone and git objects, the unit and timer files, systemctl --user show and the systemd user journal, and the coordinator's read-only reconciliation outputs for account 2. Figures present in two or more sources were cross-checked by assertion, and a mismatch stops the build. Other fields come from one source; field_provenance names them. No credential, account id, account number, account fingerprint, broker order id, activity id, execution id, pid, invocation id or host path is recorded.
